mission: Capacity75 session 8 (2026-10-10): deliver PR #96's per-turn browser code (already merged at 419210d) through the verified sequential rollout, after Railway's GitHub integration auto-built it on all ten collectors in parallel and they were restored to verified 05f099d images; recovery scan skips image-less marked records

impacts.reason: original_source skipped nothing when a marked SKIPPED record (no imageDigest) was newest: digest() raised and aborted the recovery scan (rollback attempt 1, 10:00-10:29Z, made no change). It now skips image-less candidates. Regression test. This PR's merge requests the ten-collector sequential release of the merged PR #96 code (AMBER).
Collector-directory merges deploy every collector at once via Railway watch patterns; deliver collector code with a scripts/docs-only follow-up PR; PR edits re-run delivery.

resources.name: Staging Postgres (no migration; ordinary scheduled captures only)

routes: Existing admitted ordinary due-work captures on yuyu-tei.jp and snkrdunk.com; fewer homepage and subresource requests per capture; no manual source invocation
dependencies: Freshness admission/reservation/settle fence unchanged per attempt; f9e5b4a8c012 schema; daily-v1 writer unchanged
impact.deployment_impact: This merge changes no collector watch path (scripts/docs only), so Railway builds no collector from GitHub. Its merge commit contains PR #96's code, which the sequential delivery uploads to each collector ONE AT A TIME in its own safe slot and verifies before the next. Crons, start commands, budgets, reservations, pacing, claim cap, SNKR singleton and daily-v1 variables unchanged and re-verified after each.

recovery.procedure: Automatic during rollout: every touched collector restored newest-first to its verified 05f099d image (deployments listed in collector_services, restored 10:35-11:00Z) via collector_variables.restore. After delivery: python3 scripts/collector_variables.py --service <name> --commit 05f099db30e735605fb72b542699ac75559ad8d7 --expect-digest <digest> --restore --set RAW_DICTIONARY_STORAGE_ENABLED=true --set RAW_DICTIONARY_STORAGE_MODE=daily-v1 --set APP_ENV=staging, one at a time. A native revert of PR #96 touches collector paths and would again auto-build every collector; avoid it, restore images instead and fix forward.
recovery.trigger: any 403/429/challenge/source_denial; capture or parse regression; requests per capture not lower; reservation exceeded; lease/reservation leak; turn browser errors above baseline; freshness regression; deployment failure; schedule or flag drift
recovery.backup: No schema or stored-data change. Verified 05f099d images restored and redeployable (evidence/live-after-rollback in the session-8 handoff).

verification.observation_window: Delivery artifact plus completed natural runs on the new component for SNKR and all nine shards. Then: requests per capture and budget peak below the 24h baseline (Yuyu 55.3, SNKR 160-172; peaks 94.0%/95.4%), identical prices on sampled mappings, 0 denials/403/429/challenges, no reservation overrun or lease leak, freshness unchanged, SNKR homepage RAW rows ~ warm-ups. Unverified-build evidence already measured: 56 Yuyu captures avg 30.6-33.5 requests, 56/56 identical prices.
